technology_name: METHOD TO PREPARE A HYDROPHOBIC MEMBRANE FOR RESOURCE RECOVERY USING COUNTER-CURRENT FLOW MEMBRANE DISTILLATION MODULE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Extracting concentrated chemical resources like pure ammonia from municipal or industrial wastewater grids suffers from low separation selectivities and early membrane fouling.
description: A chemical fabrication technique to prepare a robust hydrophobic polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) filtration layer integrated with active zinc-based ($ZnCO\text{-}BTC$) metal-organic framework (MOF) nanoparticles to enhance flux limits.
applications: Industrial ammonia recovery systems, chemical fertilizer processing plants, toxic manufacturing wastewater remediation, and sustainable textile print line filters.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
